optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Recommendation Systems Engineer, Customer Identity Verification

professionalSummary.text: Experienced engineer in training, deploying, and operating next‑best‑check recommendation models for customer identity verification.
professionalSummary.witness: Trained the next-best-check model (gradient-boosted ranking over device, document and behavioural signals) and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set on three months of held-out verification sessions.

experienceHighlights.text: Trained and evaluated a gradient‑boosted ranking model on risk signals, outperforming legacy rule sets.
experienceHighlights.witness: Trained the next-best-check model (gradient-boosted ranking over device, document and behavioural signals) and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set on three months of held-out verification sessions.

experienceHighlights.text: Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production via the model release pipeline, managing canary rollouts and coordinating with platform and compliance teams.
experienceHighlights.witness: Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production through the model release pipeline, executing the canary rollout myself under the platform team's release calendar and holding the production deployment role for the verification service.

experienceHighlights.text: Monitored production model performance for eleven months, tracking completion rate, fraud‑catch rate, and feature drift, and performed a rollback of version 2.4 after a drift alert.
experienceHighlights.witness: Operated the model in production for eleven months: monitored completion rate, fraud-catch rate and feature drift on the production dashboard, and rolled back version 2.4 once after a drift alert, recording the incident in the model incident log.

experienceHighlights.text: Documented model cards and incident logs, detailing training data, evaluation metrics, known limitations, and rollback procedures.
experienceHighlights.witness: Work sample: the model card for version 2.4 (training data window, evaluation metrics, known limitations) and the production incident log entry for the version 2.4 rollback, with the release pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Model card for version 2.4 and production incident log entry for rollback, demonstrating documentation and incident handling.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: the model card for version 2.4 (training data window, evaluation metrics, known limitations) and the production incident log entry for the version 2.4 rollback, with the release pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.

skills.text: Model training, production deployment, monitoring, release coordination, documentation, and incident management.
skills.witness: Responsibilities included model training, production deployment, production monitoring and release coordination for the verification service's recommendation model.

No evidence is provided regarding the candidate’s ability to evaluate model impact on completion and fraud‑catch rates with analytics teams, nor any mention of compliance with regulatory requirements beyond the release review.

role.roleTitle: Recommendation Systems Engineer, Customer Identity Verification

evidence.text: Trained the next-best-check model (gradient-boosted ranking over device, document and behavioural signals) and evaluated it offline against the previous rule set on three months of held-out verification sessions.

Deployed model versions 2.3 and 2.4 to production through the model release pipeline, executing the canary rollout myself under the platform team's release calendar and holding the production deployment role for the verification service.

Operated the model in production for eleven months: monitored completion rate, fraud-catch rate and feature drift on the production dashboard, and rolled back version 2.4 once after a drift alert, recording the incident in the model incident log.
Coordinated each release with the platform and compliance teams in the release review; compliance signed the model change record and the platform lead approved the rollout window.

Work sample: the model card for version 2.4 (training data window, evaluation metrics, known limitations) and the production incident log entry for the version 2.4 rollback, with the release pipeline run identifiers as a verification trail.
